History 2013-II.question: The Mansabdari system of the Mughals was a complex system. Its efficient functioning depended upon
History 2013-II.explanation: (c)  Mansabdari was a system of army and civil services introduced by Akbar in place of the Jagirdari system. The 'Mansab' is an Arabic word meaning rank or position or status of a person. During the early reign of Akbar, the lowest grade was ten and the highest was 5000. Akbar introduced the rank of 'Zat' and 'Sawar' in the Mansabdari system.
